text: Sixteen-year-old Alice Palmer drowns while swimming at a dam in Ararat, Australia, and her family [struggles to come to terms with her loss|who_suffers|the grieving]. Soon there are noises in the house, bruises on her brother Mathew, and [a figure in his photographs of the backyard|images|pictures, screens and recordings]. As the Palmers dig, they find a hidden videotape involving the neighbours and the footage of a school trip to Lake Mungo, where Alice, walking the shore at night, [met a bloated, drowned version of herself|threat|impostors and doubles] floating toward her.
